steps.en: Letters and data files are sent to the print vendor
steps.id: Letter dan data file dikirim ke vendor cetak
steps.why_en: The daily automatic run is switched off and uploads to the vendor are blocked by production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman otomatis harian tidak aktif, dan upload ke vendor diblok oleh konfigurasi production.

steps.en: A daily summary report of letters sent is generated
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan harian jumlah letter terkirim dibuat

steps.en: The report lists the details of each letter sent
steps.id: Report memuat detail tiap letter yang dikirim
steps.why_en: Postal numbers exist only after the vendor replies, and the report only uses today's date.
steps.why_id: Nomor registrasi pos baru ada setelah vendor membalas, dan report hanya memakai tanggal hari ini.

steps.en: The report includes sending errors to the vendor, if any
steps.id: Report memuat error pengiriman ke vendor jika ada
steps.why_en: The report only holds counts. Vendor errors are only in logs and reply files, not in the report.
steps.why_id: Report hanya berisi jumlah. Error vendor cuma ada di log dan file balasan, bukan di laporan.

steps.en: The report is produced automatically every day
steps.why_en: Only the detailed report is scheduled daily. The summary report only runs through a manual button.
steps.why_id: Hanya report detail yang terjadwal harian. Report ringkasan hanya jalan lewat tombol manual.

steps.en: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard only shows raw files. The Excel reports the system builds are only sent by email.
steps.why_id: Dashboard hanya menampilkan file mentah. Report Excel yang dibuat sistem hanya dikirim lewat email.

steps.en: The OIC can download the report to see the letter details
steps.id: OIC bisa download report untuk melihat detail letter
steps.why_en: The Reminder function has no download permission in the backend, so the download may be refused depending on role.
steps.why_id: Fungsi Reminder tidak punya izin download di backend, jadi download bisa ditolak tergantung role.
